description: This file defines the LDAPTestConnectionAPI class which provides an API endpoint for testing LDAP server connections within the OrangeHRM system. It handles request validation, initiates LDAP connection tests, and returns categorized status information about the LDAP authentication and user lookup capabilities.

classes.name: LDAPTestConnectionAPI
classes.description: An API endpoint class that facilitates testing LDAP server connections and verification within the OrangeHRM system, including authentication and user lookup checks.
